notes.Current Balance/Total Balance Due: The itemized 'Total de cargos actuales' ($105.51) plus 'Ajustes' ($0.00) doesn't reconcile to the headline 'Total a pagar' ($134.28) printed three times on this document (top summary box, second Resumen de Cuenta box, and remittance stub) - looks like a synthetic-data generation inconsistency in the source document, not an extraction error. Ground truth uses the repeated, prominent $134.28 figure.
notes.BalanceGreaterCheck: Neither extractor produced a value. Current ($134.28) > Previous ($118.74), so 'Yes'.
notes.Category: BDA read 'ELECTRICIDAD' (matching the header 'FACTURA DE ELECTRICIDAD'/Electricity Bill); LLM read 'Residencial R-1', which is actually the rate plan/tariff (Tarifa), not the utility category - 'Electricidad' is used for consistency with how the English-language sibling document's Category field ('Electricity') is read.
notes.Is_NumMeterIDsListed: Neither extractor produced a confident value and the field's intended semantics aren't clear from this document.
notes.Usage.power factor: No single per-kWh 'power factor' value exists - the itemized table has three different per-kWh rates ($0.06400, $0.09850, $0.00200) for different charge types, unlike the sibling render.pdf which has one unambiguous 'Rate per kWh'.
notes.MeterRead: Current/Delta/Previous values printed/derived with a "kWh" suffix (e.g. "15842 kWh"); kept as bare numbers here since these are 'number'-typed fields and the unit already lives separately in MeterRead.Usage Unit ("kWh").
